kitDescription: Crust is a Water rocket-launcher Supporter whose whole kit is team buffing — she has no damage skill of her own. Her attacks toggle her between two mutually exclusive cooking stances: Maillard (from 3 uncharged shots) or Blanching (from 3 held full charges), and either stance gives all allies an ATK buff equal to 10% of her own ATK. She also grants the team a small DEF buff and a debuff cleanse (Reliable Cooking), and whenever the team enters Full Burst she gives everyone holding a stance an ATK buff worth 20% of her ATK. Her burst gives all allies +20% Attack Damage, plus a stance-dependent extra: +60% Distributed Damage under Maillard or +10% Sustained Damage under Blanching. Because the sim's launcher always full-charges, Blanching is the stance that actually occurs in simulation, so the Sustained branch is the live one and the Distributed branch never fires by default.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: every kit line is either FAITHFUL or a DOCUMENTED_GAP, and all four load-bearing lines (S1 Blanching casterAtkPct 10, S2 fullBurstEnter casterAtkPct 20, burst attackDamagePct 20, burst sustainedDamagePct 10 mode-gated) carry frame- or counterfactual-level discrimination that the named nearest-wrong models provably fail. The Blanching-default mode encoding is faithful: the RL-always-full-charge premise is independently grounded in the mechanics SSOT (§4, DATAMINED einkk always-full-charge), so the Maillard family is genuinely unreachable by default, and the driver's H0/H6 pin the reviewer's most important negative assertion (zero distributedDamagePct 60 in a default run) — the 60% over-credit trap is closed, with Maillard preserved as a documented opt-in mode rather than dropped. The unmodeled lines (duration +2.5s extensions, stance removals, no-refresh gate, debuff cleanse) are all no-primitive or derivably-inert gaps documented verbatim in the override, with the S2b/S6 inertness arithmetic agreeing; the inert defPct encoding of the caster-DEF line is acceptable — both blind agents converged on it, the ⚑ approximation (no casterDefPct StatKey) is recorded with the correct future recipe, and the driver proves byte-identical totals when stripped. All 7 S5 blind-test failures are correctly attributed to blind-side artifacts, not faithfulness errors: 5 to S5's controlComp fixture bug (crown pre-empts the B2 slot so crust casts 0 bursts — S5's own fixture-sanity assertion fails against its own fixture, corroborating the driver's burst census), 1 to a durationShots null-vs-undefined assertion bug, and 1 to S5's ungated status model being less faithful than the mutually-exclusive mode gate (a RECON_ERROR, not a driver gotcha). The 16 passing blind assertions independently corroborate casterAtkPct flat scaling, team-wide targeting, fullBurstEnter identity, DEF inertness, and flavor-scoping; the S6 blind override converges block-for-block with the driver. Minor nits noted but not gotchas: the driver test's header comment describing S1 as a 'duration-less passive with expiresFrame null' is stale (the override ships durationSec 10 and the assertions correctly pin 600-frame windows — comment/implementation mismatch only), and the driver's unmodeled.skill2 omits the verbatim '3 normal, non-Full-Charge attacks' trigger line that S6 listed (the payload is encoded merged and inert, so this is documentation completeness, not a silent drop). Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the entire verdict rides on the DATAMINED RL-always-full-charge premise and the unmeasured '>1s maintain' dwell convention (⚑) — if a real crust recording ever shows tap-fire play or a slower Blanching cadence, the mode choice (a 60% Distributed vs 10% Sustained burst swing) must be re-picked from footage before trusting a board reading.
